summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A. furnished a Form 6-K containing its press release and unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports net income attributable to the group of Ps.329,308 million for the first half, down 25% versus 6M 2025, and quarterly net income of Ps.258,322 million, up 12% year-over-year. Key metrics include ROE of 11.3%, capital ratio of 23.7%, and efficiency ratio of 35.0%. This is a routine earnings disclosure for a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation corporate event.
